subject.title: fix(cli): bound model run image reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: What Windows behavior and acquisition mechanism should OpenClaw require so a user-supplied non-regular image path cannot block model-run startup before validation?
rationale: Node's current Windows fallback deliberately uses ordinary read flags, and the repository needs an explicit supported-platform policy or implementation choice before treating the availability hardening as complete.

options.title: Add a Windows-safe acquisition path
options.body: Implement and prove a Windows-specific path that rejects blocking non-regular inputs before the CLI waits; this is the recommended merge condition.

options.title: Narrow the supported guarantee
options.body: Document that the nonblocking special-file guarantee is POSIX-only and accept the remaining Windows behavior deliberately.

options.title: Pause this hardening
options.body: Keep the existing behavior until a portable design can be selected and validated on Windows.

recommendation.title: Add a Windows-safe acquisition path
recommendation.body: Implement and prove a Windows-specific path that rejects blocking non-regular inputs before the CLI waits; this is the recommended merge condition.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest commit owns the platform split that needs a precise Windows follow-up.
